nodes.name: HRIS Webhook
nodes.notes: HRIS -> n8n webhook. HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-HRIS-Signature. Secret: WEBHOOK_HMAC_SECRET (server-side only).

nodes.name: Verify HMAC
nodes.notes: Reject 401 on mismatch. expected = hex(hmac_sha256(WEBHOOK_HMAC_SECRET, rawBody)).

nodes.name: Validate Hire
nodes.notes: Required: name, start_date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional passthrough: role, dept, region, timezone, manager_id, buddy_id.

nodes.name: Build Idempotency Key
nodes.notes: Key = {hire_id}:{start_date}. Duplicate HRIS event -> single case (API returns 200 existing).

nodes.name: POST Trigger
nodes.notes: POST {API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/onboarding/trigger with Idempotency-Key + X-Service-Key. Retry 3x backoff (2s/10s/60s); on final failure route to DLQ node.

nodes.name: Backoff 2s-10s-60s
nodes.notes: Wait node chain models runner backoff schedule between retries of POST Trigger.

nodes.name: DLQ to HR Inbox
nodes.notes: After retries exhausted: email raw payload + error to HR DLQ mailbox for manual replay.
